title: Conditions of service of [2][Chairperson, members and Member-Secretary.]
text:
9. Conditions of service of [Chairperson, members and Member-Secretary.]—The term of office

and conditions of service of the Chairperson and the other members other than ex officio members of the
National Biodiversity Authority [and of Member-Secretary] shall be such as may be prescribed by the
Central Government.
